candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 preceding order 502 across all sampled correlation IDs; inventory/reservations succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side logs/metrics excluded; root cause within payment (config, saturation) not established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to payment returning 503 on authorizations; order fails downstream. Inventory path healthy. Payment-internal cause unconfirmed; logs excluded from context.
